title: ProfiCook Double Air Fryer — 9 L, Dual Chamber, 9 Programmes, Touchscreen
short_description: An XXL double air fryer with 9 litres (2 x 4.5 L dual chamber), 9 programmes, touchscreen and 2400 watts. Fry with hot air without additional oil.
long_description: The ProfiCook double air fryer PC-FR 1242 H offers 9 litres total volume split into two separate 4.5-litre chambers — so you can prepare two dishes at once. It fries with hot air without additional oil for lower-fat results. 9 automatic programmes, touchscreen control and 2400 watts make cooking easy and fast. The non-stick containers are easy to clean and automatic shut-off adds safety. Ideal for families and anyone who wants to cook healthier and more flexibly.
buying_angle: Practical for families who want to prepare two dishes at once and with less fat — with plenty of volume and easy touchscreen control.
